title: Continuation from equal register records
statement: Let $a,b,f,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $m$ be a Boolean mode, let $o$ be an oracle on five indices and Boolean words, and let $y$ be a Boolean word. Let $st,st'$ be register records, $l$ a machine label, and $c$ an abstract machine configuration. If $st=st'$ and the machine $A(a,b,f,m)$ reaches $c$ from label $l$ with register values $st'$, no result recorded, and the guard satisfied at every earlier time, then it also reaches $c$ from label $l$ with register values $st$, no result recorded, and the same guard satisfied at every earlier time.
hypotheses_covered: $o$ is an oracle on five indices and Boolean words
The machine reaches $c$ from the specified initial configuration while the guard holds at every earlier time
replaced:
Let $a,b,f,B$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{mode}$ be Boolean, let $o$ be an oracle
on five indices and Boolean words, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let
$\mathrm{st},\mathrm{st}'$ be register records, $l$ a machine label, and $c$ a machine
configuration. If $\mathrm{st}=\mathrm{st}'$ and the machine reaches $c$ from label $l$
with registers $\mathrm{st}'$, with no answer recorded and its guard satisfied
throughout, then it also reaches $c$ from label $l$ with registers $\mathrm{st}$, under
the same guard.
